meta.name: add-gchat
meta.description: Add Google Chat channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过 Chat SDK 为应用接入 Google Chat 渠道。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想让它能收发 Google Chat 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add Google Chat integration to your app via the Chat SDK.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app and need Google Chat messaging.

howto.what: 它把 Google Chat 适配器从 channels 分支复制进项目、追加一行注册导入、装好 @chat-adapter/gchat@4.29.0,再构建并跑一条注册测试。Google Cloud 凭据与配置仍需你手动完成。
howto.when: 当你想给项目接入 Google Chat 渠道时接管,按 Apply 步骤改代码并跑构建与测试;若你正在 /setup 流程中,完成后返回该流程。

say.text: 帮我给项目加上 Google Chat 渠道
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册导入、装依赖、跑构建和测试

say.text: 提示我粘贴服务账号 JSON 并写入 .env
say.note: 以单行字符串写入,已有值不会被覆盖

say.text: 跑一下 gchat 的注册测试
say.note: 红色说明导入行或依赖出了问题

howto.what_en: It copies the Google Chat adapter from the channels branch into the project, appends one registration import, installs @chat-adapter/gchat@4.29.0, then builds and runs the registration test. Google Cloud credentials stay manual.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you want to add a Google Chat channel to the project, editing code and running the build and test; if you're mid-/setup, return to that flow afterward.

say_en.text: Add the Google Chat channel to my project
say_en.note: Copies adapter, registers, installs dep, builds and tests

say_en.text: Ask me for the service account JSON and write it to .env
say_en.note: Stored as a single line; existing value not overwritten
Red means the import or the dependency drifted
